submissions.title: THE YELLOW PAPER TAG LORE MAGA: EDITION 001
submissions.description:
THE YELLOW PAPER TAG LORE — MANGA: EDITION 001

In a world filled with endless paper tags, each one waits to be chosen.
Most remain lifeless.
But every so often, a bidder makes a choice.
One paper tag is selected.
STAMPED BY THE YELLOW COLLECTIVE.
The moment the stamp hits, something changes.
The chosen tag awakens.
It doesn't understand what happened. It doesn't know why it was selected. It only knows that it is no longer just a piece of paper.
Surrounded by countless others, it pulls itself from the ground.
And begins to ascend.
The bid was the choice.
The stamp was the awakening.
And this was the first Yellow Paper Tag.

submissions.title: Onchain guy
submissions.description:
​° Panel 1: The character sits at a desk typing on a laptop with a monitor showing "Yellow Collective NFT collection". A narration box reads: "Grible's just a regular 'onchain guy'... creating stuff." The character says, "I hope people like my new collection."  

​°Panel 2: The character looks shocked at the computer screen. The narration box explains: "...until someone finds his minting contract on Warpcast (Farcaster)."  

​°Panel 3: Overwhelmed, the character holds a smartphone as Warpcast frames, notification bubbles, and mini Nouns-style avatar heads pop up all around. Narration says: "Then, the Nouns arrive! Frame after frame!" A speech bubble reads: "'Dude, did you see the mint frame on Grible's cast? Instant mint!'"  

​Panel 4: Standing triumphantly in his blue "SUPER BASED" hoodie with a tongue-out smile, the character gives a thumbs-up. Next to him are an Ethereum symbol trophy and a scroll titled "YELLOW COLLECTIVE ARCHIVES". He announces: "Guess it was SUPER BASED! Collective win!"
